about_the_game:
• When It All Began

Birmingham, England, ES 1965. Corruption within the English police force, along with the rampant activity of street gangs constantly disrupts the entire nation. The Red Order, once renowned as an anti-crime organisation dating back centuries, now prospers in England as the dominant provider of health products. However, beneath this façade lies a sinister secret. 

After his relocation to Birmingham, Detective James is summoned to aid the investigation of a curious homicide on Highburn Street. Despite the impact of his artificial dementia, and being haunted by a demon, James dives deep into an investigation that ultimately makes his condition deteriorate.

• What You’re Walking Into

Thief’s Shelter is a first-person psychological mystery that unearths buried trauma, twisted ambitions, and the inhuman forces pulling the strings behind it all. James' research is intertwined with his own personal struggles, such as the artificial dementia along with its effects.


As investigation unfolds, you will fight James’ deteriorating mental state, experience hallucinations, and confront buried memories. Explore Highburn Mansion that distorts as you progress, search for clues and use investigative tools to reveal secrets hidden in plain sight.

• Truth lies in what YOU notice 

Every clue matters — and some only show themselves once. Overlook a detail, and it may never return.

Thief’s Shelter adapts to what YOU discover. Some journal entries never appear. Certain scenes never happen. Memory is fragile and so is the truth.

Following the main path will get you to the end. But it won’t give you the full picture. To truly enrich your knowledge of this universe, you must break away, explore, experiment. What you uncover reflects your perception. What you miss defines your version of the truth.

There are no second chances. Stay sharp.

• Tools for the Truth

Puzzles in Thief’s Shelter reward observation and deduction, not guesswork. To reach the end, you will have to recover four key artifacts tied to the mansion. You’ll solve multi-stage mechanical contraption, decode cryptic symbols, and unlock rooms that shouldn’t exist.


James records new findings in his Memoir, with important evidence logged under Investigation Notes. Use tools like the UV light and the digital camera to reveal secrets hidden in plain sight, then reference your notes to find the solution. 


Certain discoveries don’t surface the first time.

Or the second.

Not everything in Thief’s Shelter will reveal itself in one playthrough. VHS tapes, Masks, Red Order conspiracies, James’ past, and other events can be missed on your first try.

• A Modern Take on a Classic Genre

Thief’s Shelter modernizes the point-and-click genre made popular by Myst and The Secret of Monkey Island. This is a cinematic experience with smooth movement and rich, highly detailed 3D environments.

Navigation flows naturally. No aimless backtracking. Optional hints and smart waypoint filtering keep you immersed in the mystery.

• Key Features

  • Shifting Environments. Highburn Mansion shifts as you make story progression revealing new areas whilst altering existing ones.

  • Player Agency. Clues can vanish. Overlook a detail, and it may never resurface. While the investigation moves forward, what you miss shapes what you understand — or fail to. The world won't stop for you to catch up.

  • Puzzles. Every challenge in Thief’s Shelter is built around observation and deduction. No guesswork, no obscure riddles — just grounded, logic-based puzzles that reward attention to detail and investigative thinking.

  • Tools. Use the UV light and or the digital camera to reveal what the naked eye misses. Collected evidence is documented in James’ Memoir, influencing his psychological state and the game’s narrative.

  • Replayability. Discover the deeper truth through multiple investigations. Hidden VHS tapes, secret artifacts, and various journal entries reveal the mansion’s darkest threads.

  • Streamlined Mystery. Classic adventure gameplay — modernized. No random wandering. No cheap jumpscares. Just slow-building dread, meaningful choices, and immersive narrative.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work. General mature content is present, during cutscenes or in game sequences.

name: Thief's Shelter

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2500X or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible, headphones recommended
  • Additional Notes: An SSD is recommended for game installation.

short_description: Uncover what happened at Highburn Mansion—before it unravels your mind. Investigate, solve intricate puzzles, document elusive evidence, and question every shadow. Thief’s Shelter is a first-person mystery where the deeper you dig, the more reality slips away.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Greek, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
